1.consolidated_definition: Desternillarse (de la risa): sentirse profundamente divertido o entretenido hasta el punto de no poder contener la risa.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be in stitches (with laughter): to feel deeply amused or entertained to the point of being unable to contain one's laughter.
